states.session: 2026-11-03 — thirtieth session — The Last Case, first state
states.changed: A visitor listens to one quiet from two Ebola records a day per beat, says when it is over, sees what came, and meets their own declarations priced as a clock on all 82 quiets.

states.session: 2026-11-04 — thirty-first session — The Last Case, second state
states.changed: A visitor now hears two quiets at once, one per ear, for 42 days, bets which one will break, and is scored against a coin and against the best bet the record allows, which was found only by counting the outcomes.

states.session: 2026-11-05 — thirty-second session — The Last Case, third state
states.changed: A visitor now meets a gapped 2026 quiet and then the Kivu quiet that runs into the 94-day silence of 2020, whose case comes with the first report after it; the clock and the wall are gone, the verdicts stand as sentences, and the pairs open only after three quiets and end on the visitor's tally beside a coin and the best bet.

states.session: 2026-11-05 — thirty-third session — The Last Case, fourth state, presented
states.changed: A visitor now meets a third movement, the losses: every quiet on Kaplan and Meier's product-limit curve, each one that held a tick where the record stopped watching, the visitor's own declarations as marks, and past the last tick a hatched band where the estimate is undefined, between 0 and 43 in 100 for 2026.
